name: Zhenyuanopterus
isnote: It has been suggested that it is the adult of Boreopterus.
sum: Long-snouted, crested boreopterid from the Yixian Formation of Liaoning, China, with 172 needle-like teeth.
material: Complete skeleton (skull 54.5 cm); a second partial specimen.
biology: Very long needle-like front teeth; perhaps caught small fish while swimming.
author: Lü 2010

species.name: Zhenyuanopterus longirostris
species.author: Lü 2010
